subject: Onboarding MOP: Identity & network guardrails for Orphic Systems
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@orphic.com>, Tom Bell <tom.bell@orphic.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding MOP: Identity & network guardrails for Orphic Systems

Hi Samira / Tom —

Follow-up from our kickoff: attached is the mutual action plan (MOP) for identity and network guardrails. High-level asks so we can align owners and schedule the cutover window: 

- Confirm SAML IdP redirect URI and test SP metadata (we need the production redirect and a staging redirect).
- Confirm SCIM attribute mapping for users (email, username, groups, title, department).
- Provide the IP ranges you will use for outbound traffic to Redwood (we'll supply a collector to verify).
- Approve the recommended service-account naming pattern and role matrix so we can provision service identities ahead of cutover.
- Agree on org policy baselines (session length, MFA enforcement for admin roles).

Proposed timing: a two-week window with a dry-run in week 1 and cutover weekend in week 2 (suggested dry-run: Sep 11–12; cutover candidate: Sep 18–19). If that works, Karthik will open the implementation tickets and assign owners.

Attachments (stubs): orphic_mop_v1.pdf (MOP), svcacct_map.xlsx (service-account template), ip_allowlist_template.csv

Next steps (explicit asks):
1) Samira — send IdP metadata and the list of IP blocks by end of day Sep 4.
2) Tom — procurement: can you confirm whether the PO needs DocuSign prior to any staging work?
3) Monica/Karthik — internal owners will create Jira tasks and a rollback checklist by Sep 7.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping the momentum.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Onboarding MOP: Identity & network guardrails for Orphic Systems

Thanks Jordan — this looks good. Quick answers and a few clarifying questions: 

- We can share IdP metadata tomorrow morning (our Okta admin is Oren). We have a staging redirect URI ready.
- IP ranges: attaching a CSV export of our current egress ranges (attachment: orphic_ip_blocks.csv). We will confirm whether all ranges will be NATed through the same public blocks or split per VPC.
- SCIM mapping: we currently send email, displayName, title, department and groups. We do not provision manager attribute today. Is manager required for Redwood?
- Service accounts: can you share the recommended RBAC matrix? We are sensitive about long-lived keys and prefer short-lived tokens via our KMS.
- Procurement: Tom — we prefer DocuSign first for the order; can Redwood provision staging access on NDA/KBA while procurement finishes the PO?

Also request: we need a SOC2 encrypt-at-rest certificate and confirmation of IAM audit logs being retained for at least 12 months for our security team. Is that part of the onboarding pack?

—
Samira Khan
Identity & Security Lead
Orphic Systems
samira.k@orphic.com
+1 (212) 555-0103

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@orphic.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tom Bell <tom.bell@orphic.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding MOP: Identity & network guardrails for Orphic Systems

Samira — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications and an implementation sketch below.

1) Manager attribute: not required for Redwood authorization; we use groups for admin/role assignment. Manager is optional unless you want org-chart-driven access.

2) Service-account pattern & RBAC (stub):
   - Naming: redwood-sa-<env>-<team>-<purpose> (e.g., redwood-sa-prod-billing-ingest)
   - Keys/rotation: we recommend short-lived credentials obtained through your KMS + OIDC flow to Redwood's token service (we can exchange metadata for a one-time OIDC trust). If the KMS path is not available, we'll provision scoped long-lived tokens and enforce rotation every 90 days.
   - Roles: read-only ingest, admin:policy, admin:entitlements. We'll attach the detailed matrix to the Jira tasks.

3) SCIM mapping suggestions: email -> primaryEmail (required), displayName -> name, groups -> groupMemberships (we will accept external groupUUID mapping), title/department optional. I'll include a JSON example in the drive link.

4) IP allowlist strategy and verification:
   - We can accept a set of CIDR blocks for TLS termination and API egress. Please indicate whether you expect to NAT behind a couple of stable egress IPs.
   - During dry-run we will deploy a collector that records incoming tunnel IPs and correlates to your list; rollback will immediately disable the collector.

5) Evidence (SOC2 / logs): Monica — we will upload a standard security onboarding packet (SOC2 type II cover letter, encryption at rest confirmation, and audit log retention policy) to the drive folder by EOD Sep 7. Samira: this should satisfy the security team's request for initial evidence.

6) Implementation timeline (high level):
   - Sep 7: Jira tasks created + attachments uploaded.
   - Sep 11–12: Dry-run in staging (non-prod user sync, basic SAML flow test, collector verification).
   - Sep 18–19: Production cutover window (final sync, disable old auth path).

Action items I will do this week: create Jira epic ORPH-ONB-1, add subtasks for SAML metadata import, SCIM mapping validation, IP verification, service-account provisioning, and create rollback/monitoring runbook.

Attachments referenced: svcacct_map.xlsx (template) — I will pre-populate this and share the link.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 15:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding MOP: Identity & network guardrails for Orphic Systems

Samira / team —

Thanks for confirming the initial details. Quick status update and items for sign-off: 

- Jordan/Karthik: the Jira epic ORPH-ONB-1 has been created and tickets assigned (links in Drive).
- Karthik: please upload the JSON SCIM example and the populated svcacct_map.xlsx; Samira, review and comment by Sep 10.
- Security docs: I've uploaded the SOC2 excerpt, encryption note, and audit-log retention statement to the shared drive (link in related_links).
- Procurement: Tom — per Samira, Orphic prefers DocuSign prior to PO. We have prepared the order form and will send the DocuSign envelope once Samira confirms the purchase contact. (Attachment stub: docusign_order_link.txt)

If Orphic can confirm the final IP blocks and IdP metadata by Sep 4 (or close), we'll keep the dry-run dates. If not, propose we move the dry-run to Sep 15.

Final ask for now: Samira — can you confirm the purchase contact and whether your security team needs the manager attribute or additional SCIM attributes?

Thanks — looking forward to the first dry-run.

—
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
